resources.string:
Welcome to Umineko Project! Before the chessboard is set, we must tend to some technical details. 

ONScripter is a legacy, cross-platform engine that reads game files directly from storage. Modern Android devices require All Files Access for it to function. 

Instructions: 

1. Create a dedicated folder and place the Umineko Project game files inside. You'll need at least 13GB of free space. You can download the required files from https://www.umineko-project.org/en/downloads/ 

2. Tap Choose game folder and select the folder you created. (Note: Android may not allow selecting certain folders like Downloads or the top level of internal storage.)
onscripter-new ran into an unexpected error. The log below includes the crash details and what the engine was doing beforehand.
No game folder selected. The app folder is:\n%1$s
That location has no path on this device. Pick a folder on internal storage or an SD card rather than a cloud provider.
Cannot read %1$s.\nGrant all-files access, then pick the folder again.
Could not save the selected game folder.
Could not restart the engine. Close and reopen the app.
This device has no all-files access screen. Grant the permission with:\nadb shell appops set org.umineko_project.onscripter_ru MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow
